text: Large but disciplined refactor: new dependency-free value objects remove duplication and the eight method splits keep orchestration semantics. Verified tests/lint pass and no credential or setting-alias violations. Remaining notes are minor polish items only.

message: Centralizing slugs, base URLs, and availability keys in a dependency-free Catalog keeps slim bootstraps (entry bust hook, uninstall, Settings) correct without loading SDK-trait classes, with literal fail-open fallbacks.

Named factories (verified/unknown/notConfigured/networkError/noCredits/invalidKey/rateLimited/serverError) remove the 6-arg result bag while classify() preserves probe semantics (2xx, 401+CreditsError, 429).
Bust hook stays credential-blind (transient deletes only, separate Go/Zen setting names untouched) and resolves the Catalog class correctly under the file-level OpenCodeConnector namespace.

verified() now persists the actual 2xx status (e.g. 201/204) into the cached result instead of always 200, so the 'no behavior change' claim is slightly imprecise for consumers reading the status field.
PREFIX const alias plus transientKeys()/allTransientKeys() wrappers duplicate Catalog::AVAIL_PREFIX; a future edit to PREFIX alone would silently fork the two sources.
New code and helpers are tagged @since 0.1.7 while the plugin Version header and VERSION const remain 0.1.6, a forward version reference until the release bump lands.
